textColorInversion.description: On transparent/default state, nav text is white to contrast with hero. When dropdown opens, header becomes solid white and text changes to black.

triggers.description: Hovering any nav item with a dropdown causes header to transition to solid white background. Active nav item gets a teal underline indicator.
triggers.headerEffect: solid-white background, box-shadow or subtle border may appear
triggers.textEffect: nav text color changes from white to black

triggers.description: When any dropdown/megamenu panel is open, header stays solid white
triggers.headerEffect: solid-white background persists while panel is open

notes: The header is transparent by default (overlaps hero), transitions to solid white when any dropdown is hovered/opened. Text color inverts from white to black. No body padding-top since content sits behind the transparent header. The .header-blur class is always present but the background changes via inline styles or additional classes when interaction occurs.
